svg.title: EINSTEIN matchmaker architecture
svg.desc: An Orchestrator hands work to four Industry Analysts, six Research Profilers, one Matchmaker and three Proposal Writers. They share one blackboard (MatchState) and one Mozaik event bus. A Critic with a second reviewer checks every artifact as it lands and sends rejected claims back to their producer. Every model call goes through a ResilientRunner with rate limits, retries and a budget stop. A trace observer writes every event to trace.jsonl for the web app. A person approves each pair before outreach. A Funding Scout finds open EU calls and related EU projects for each chosen pair.
